{{Quote|We're here because of a crime lord named Diago Hixan-the closest thing Nok Drayen ever had to a rival. Diago was always trying to one-up Nok. They fought for territory, bragging rights, and the occasional woman. The battles were legendary.|Risha Drayen|<ref name="The Lightside" />}}
'''Diago Hixan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was a sworn rival of [[Nok Drayen]] before his "death". He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a confrontation with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nariel Pridence]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Vaverone Zare]], and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who would later be known as the [[Voidhound]].

==Biography==
Before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], Diago Hixan competed with the crime lord [[Nok Drayen]] to rule the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] underworld. Over many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] two scored bigger heists, hunted for treasures, and fought across many worlds. One point of contention between them was [[Shassa Dalle]]. To Hixan's dismay, she was "stolen" by his rival Nok Drayen. Hixan spent years making impassioned attempts to win her back from Drayen, but this ended after he accidentally caused Shassa's [[Death/Legends|death]]. Following the apparent death of Nok Drayen, Hixan claimed victory. bringing many criminals throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] under his heel.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Diago Hixan (Smuggler)}}</ref>

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date2">{{TOR_dates|1}} As the class mission "The Lightside" occurs in Act I, the relevant events therefore happen in 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> a [[Voidhound|smuggler captain]] came to Tatooine to acquire a sensor computer from Diago to assist in finding the lost treasure of Nok. The smuggler contacted Diago's lieutenant, [[Tookreek]], to arrange a meeting with Diago in exchange for being known for finding the treasure. However, a Sith named [[Vaverone Zare]] was seeking a meeting with Diago too, mainly to acquire the [[Darth Nihilus' holocron|holocron]] of [[Darth Nihilus]] he possessed, and had launched attacks on his holdings to get his attention. The Sith's activity brought the attention of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nariel Pridence]].<ref name="The Lightside" />

{{GameLS}}
When all parties arrived at Diago's hideout in the [[Lightspring]], Diago refused hear any of them. At the same time, the smuggler's companion, [[Risha Drayen|Risha]] called via holo to check on her partner's progress. Diago quickly became englamoured with her, compelling her to sign off. He demanded that he meet her. Zare interrupted him, attempting to persuade him to help her kill Nariel but he would not hear her. Zare then attempted to use a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on the smuggler to turn on the Jedi but the latter proved strong willed for it to work. To add to the madness, Diago irrationally ordered his droids to attack all present. In the ensuring fight, Diago was killed, along with Zare.<ref name="The Lightside" />
{{Endgame}}
